title: VIA-1
caption: In my internship with the Union of Vietnamese Student Associations of the Midwest (UVSA-MW), I collaborated with a small team to promote the 23rd Annual Vietnamese Interacting As One (VIA-1) Conference and develop and uphold the conference's brand theme of "Level Up: The Journey Within." The Annual VIA-1 Conference brings together hundreds of young Vietnamese leaders from across the country to hone their leadership skills and explore issues in the Vietnamese-American community. Within the marketing team, our goal was to create visual communication pieces to promote attendance to thousands of local Vietnamese Student Association chapter members and unify conference branding through a variety of digital and print projects.
